title: PRC Chart Handoff Format
description: Tool-agnostic JSON handoff format for transferring charts between pewplots (R) and prc-chart-builder (WordPress). Version 1 supports the 7 core chart types shared by both tools.

version.description: Semantic version of the handoff document itself.

chartType.description: The chart type. Maps to CB layout.type. 'bar' covers both horizontal (pew_bar) and vertical (pew_column) via the orientation field.

orientation.description: Bar/column orientation. Horizontal = pew_bar(); vertical = pew_column(). Ignored for non-bar types.

data.description: The chart data in tidy/long format. Rows are observations. This is the pre-summarized data as CB expects it — pew_bar/pew_column internally summarize before storing here.

values.description: Array of data row objects. Each row must contain at minimum the xColumn and yColumn fields. Category/series fields are optional.

xColumn.description: The field name used as the independent variable (x axis). Maps to CB dataRender.x.

yColumn.description: The field name used as the dependent variable (y axis). Maps to CB dataRender.y.

categoryColumn.description: The field name for series/group differentiation (fill_by in pew_bar, color_by in pew_line). Maps to CB dataRender.categories (the unique values of this column). Null for single-series charts.

xType.description: The data type of the x/independent variable. Maps to CB dataRender.xScale ('linear' for numeric, 'time' for date, 'linear' for categorical).

yType.description: The data type of the y/dependent variable. 'percentage' indicates values are 0-100 and axis should show '%'. Maps to CB dependentAxis.tickUnit.

metadata.description: Chart text metadata. Maps directly to CB metadata.*

title.description: Chart title. Maps to CB metadata.title.

subtitle.description: Chart subtitle. Maps to CB metadata.subtitle.

note.description: Chart note (below chart). Maps to CB metadata.note.

source.description: Data source attribution. Maps to CB metadata.source.

config.description: Visual configuration. Only fields expressible by the source tool are present; everything else gets CB defaults at import time.

colors.description: Resolved hex color palette, in series order. Maps to CB colors[]. For pewplots exports, these are the resolved hex values from pew_cols() / palette_pew().

width.description: Chart width in pixels. Maps to CB layout.width.

height.description: Chart height in pixels. Maps to CB layout.height.

independentAxis.description: Independent (x) axis configuration. Maps to CB independentAxis.*

label.description: Axis label text. Maps to CB independentAxis.label.

scale.description: Axis scale type. Maps to CB independentAxis.scale.

domain.description: Explicit [min, max] domain. Null = auto. Maps to CB independentAxis.domain.

tickFormat.description: D3 format string for tick labels (e.g. ',.0f'). Maps to CB independentAxis.tickFormat.

tickUnit.description: Unit suffix/prefix on tick labels (e.g. '%', '$'). Maps to CB independentAxis.tickUnit.

tickUnitPosition.description: Whether the unit appears before or after the tick value. Maps to CB independentAxis.tickUnitPosition.

showZero.description: Whether to show a zero baseline. Maps to CB independentAxis.showZero.

dependentAxis.description: Dependent (y) axis configuration. Maps to CB dependentAxis.*

label.description: Axis label text. Maps to CB dependentAxis.label.

scale.description: Axis scale type. Maps to CB dependentAxis.scale.

domain.description: Explicit [min, max] domain. Null = auto. Maps to CB dependentAxis.domain.

tickFormat.description: D3 format string for tick labels. Maps to CB dependentAxis.tickFormat.

tickUnit.description: Unit suffix/prefix on tick labels. Maps to CB dependentAxis.tickUnit.

showZero.description: Whether to include zero in the domain. Maps to CB dependentAxis.showZero.

legend.description: Legend configuration. Maps to CB legend.*

active.description: Whether to show the legend. Maps to CB legend.active.

orientation.description: Legend layout direction. Maps to CB legend.orientation.

labels.description: Data label configuration. Maps to CB labels.*

active.description: Whether to show data labels on chart elements. Maps to CB labels.active.

position.description: Label position relative to the bar/element. Maps to CB labels.labelPositionBar.

barOptions.description: Bar/column chart options. Applied when chartType is 'bar', 'stacked-bar', or 'diverging-bar'.

barPadding.description: Padding between individual bars (0–1). Maps to CB bar.barPadding. Derived from pewplots bar_width (inverted: bar_width 0.7 ≈ barPadding 0.3).

barGroupPadding.description: Padding between bar groups in a grouped chart. Maps to CB bar.barGroupPadding.

stackOffset.description: Stack offset mode. 'expand' = 100% stacked (pew_bar position='fill'). Maps to CB bar.stackOffset.

lineOptions.description: Line chart options. Applied when chartType is 'line' or 'area'.

interpolation.description: Line interpolation mode. Maps to CB line.interpolation.

strokeWidth.description: Line stroke width in pixels. Maps to CB line.strokeWidth.

showPoints.description: Whether to show data points on the line. Maps to CB line.showPoints. In pewplots this is pew_line() points parameter (none=false, extremes/final/all/specific=true).

areaFillOpacity.description: Fill opacity for area charts. Maps to CB line.areaFillOpacity. pewplots pew_area(opaque=TRUE) sets this to 1.0.

dotPlotOptions.description: Dot plot chart options. Applied when chartType is 'dot-plot'.

connectPoints.description: Whether to draw a connecting line between dot pairs. Maps to CB dotPlot.connectPoints. Corresponds to pewplots pew_dotplot() diff_bar parameter.

scatterOptions.description: Scatter plot options. Applied when chartType is 'scatter'.

showRegressionLine.description: Whether to show a regression/fit line. Maps to CB regression.active. Corresponds to pewplots pew_scatter() fit_line parameter.

regressionType.description: Regression line type. Maps to CB regression.type. Corresponds to pewplots pew_scatter() fit_line (always 'lm' = linear).

divergingBarOptions.description: Diverging bar chart options. Applied when chartType is 'diverging-bar'.

positiveCategories.description: Category values that belong on the positive (right) side. Maps to CB divergingBar.positiveCategories.

negativeCategories.description: Category values that belong on the negative (left) side. Maps to CB divergingBar.negativeCategories.

source.description: Provenance: which tool created this file and when.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the file was exported.

originalCall.description: The original R function call that produced this chart (e.g. 'pew_bar(df, x=country, y=share, fill_by=group)'). For debugging only.

palette.description: The named pewplots palette used (e.g. 'labs', 'partisan'). Stored for round-tripping back to R. Null when exported from CB.

paletteScale.description: The palette_pew() scale mode. Null when exported from CB.

warnings.description: List of features that were dropped or approximated during export. Consumers should surface these to the user.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what was dropped and why.

metadata.title: Views of Country X
metadata.subtitle: % who have a favorable view
metadata.note: Note: Based on adults in each country.
